display.purpose: Section titles and chapter names; the hero rises to clamp(2.7rem, 6.2vw, 5.6rem). Archivo 800 at width 120.

headline.purpose: Secondary section titles and the hero subline. Archivo 750 at width 112.

title.purpose: Range names, chapter range names, service rows, mobile nav items.

lede.purpose: Section introductions, capped at 62ch, text-wrap pretty.

label.purpose: Tracked caps with tabular figures for facts only: title-block keys, sheet headers, counters, captions, drawing annotations. Size scales via --ls up to about 0.95rem.

action.purpose: Buttons, text links, title-block actions and nav, in sentence case.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out for all UI transitions (buttons, links, photo hover scale); never bounce or overshoot.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Button colour and transform transitions; arrow nudges at 0.3s, 3px.

motion.name: draw
motion.purpose: Linework draws itself in chapter figures and the intro wireframe.

motion.name: wipe
motion.value: clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) to inset(0), power2.inOut, behind a 2px gold construction line
motion.purpose: The drawing resolves into its photograph left to right.

motion.name: switch-on
motion.purpose: Final light: the lamp photograph switches on as the sheet turns navy.

motion.name: scrub
motion.purpose: Chapter transformations follow native scroll; no scroll hijacking.

motion.name: intro
motion.purpose: Lockup draws as wireframe, fills, upper panes glance and blink, star opens as a mask onto the showroom photo.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Photo shown, drawing at 38% overlay, Final light navy, no intro, no scrubbing.

narrative.northStar: The Drawing Set That Switches On
narrative.overview:
Every surface is a sheet from an architect's drawing set: cool drafting white, architectural-navy linework, real drafting conventions (sheet frames with registration ticks, dimension lines with 45° tick terminators, title blocks, schedules, grid bubbles, numbered sheets). The lines then resolve into Kenstar's own showroom photographs, and the set ends when the final light switches on in gold. The drawing is never decoration: every annotation states a fact or is a working link.

The palette comes straight from the KENST★R lockup: navy letters, a gold star that doubles as the A. Navy is used as whole fields, not accents; gold is used as light, not colour. Photography carries every other colour. Type pairs a heavy, expanded Archivo for headlines with Barlow Semi Condensed lettering for annotations and actions, so headlines read like a sheet title and labels read like a draughtsman's hand.

Density is generous and structured: hairline-ruled tables and schedules instead of cards, square corners cut at 45° instead of radii, and depth from tonal fields instead of shadows. Motion is drafting: lines draw, fills resolve, wipes travel behind a gold construction line, nothing bounces.
keyCharacteristics: Cool drafting white sheets with navy linework; navy owns whole fields.
Gold only for the star, light, and the primary action.
45° chamfers from the wordmark; gable-topped openings from the logo's house.
Expanded heavy Archivo headlines; tracked Barlow Semi Condensed lettering with tabular figures.
Hairline sheet frames, ruled title blocks and schedules; no cards, no shadows, no radii.
Drafting motion: draw, resolve, wipe. Scroll-scrubbed on native scroll, with a still resting state.

rules.name: The Gold Is Light Rule
rules.body: Gold appears only where there is a star, a light, or the primary action. There is no gold text on paper, and no gold haze or glow laid over a navy field (it reads as mud); the light lives inside photographs and marks.

rules.name: The Whole Field Rule
rules.body: Navy is applied as entire sections or panels, never as tinted cards or accent stripes. A section is either a paper sheet or a navy field.

rules.name: The Opening Rule
rules.body: Opening navy is reserved for openings and figure grounds. It is not a general dark surface.

rules.name: The Lettering States Facts Rule
rules.body: Tracked caps are for annotations that carry a fact: a key, a sheet number, a dimension, a counter, a caption. They never sit above a headline as a decorative kicker.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Action Rule
rules.body: Actions are set in sentence case Barlow semibold, never tracked caps.

rules.name: The Drawn, Not Lifted Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. Separation is a ruled line, a sheet frame, or a change of field; never a drop shadow, blur, or glass layer.

dos: **Do** set every surface as either a drafting-white sheet or a whole navy field.
**Do** keep gold to the star, light, and one primary action per view, with opening-navy text on gold.
**Do** cut corners at 45° (0.75rem on controls, about 2.25rem on panels) and keep everything else square.
**Do** carry structure with hairline rules, sheet frames, ruled title blocks and schedules.
**Do** make every annotation a fact or a working link, lettered in tracked Barlow caps on a solid plate.
**Do** switch drawing labels to numbered markers with a caption key below 768px.
**Do** move with the drafting grammar (draw, resolve, wipe behind a gold line) on expo ease-out, scrubbed to native scroll, with a still reduced-motion state.
**Do** let photography carry all colour beyond navy, white and gold.
donts: **Don't** set gold text on paper, or lay a gold haze or glow over a navy field.
**Don't** use opening navy as a general dark surface; it is for openings and figure grounds.
**Don't** add drop shadows, blur, glass, or rounded corners (true circles are kept for the status dot and grid bubbles only).
**Don't** put tracked-caps kickers or eyebrows above headlines; lettering is for annotations only.
**Don't** use cream or warm off-white for sheets; the paper is cool drafting white.
**Don't** autoplay the gateway carousel or hijack native scroll.
**Don't** use bounce, spring or overshoot easing.
